phase: P7 - semantic geometry production closure proven

items.goal: Derive a monument-class building with a live model provider through the staged production runtime: the model authors the coarse proposal, selection, geometry, and stage deepenings itself under the frozen contracts, with every failed or timed-out attempt retained and no scripted fallback.
acceptance: The live provider profile is frozen before any call and every attempt retains exact P053 envelopes; failures, rejections, and timeouts are terminal evidence, never silently retried.
The root step is authored end to end by the live model: two independent options, one selection, and compiled neutral geometry, with the harness contributing no coordinates.
At least one deepening stage extends the same component identities through a P055 exact-predecessor transaction authored by the live model.
Typed arrays authored by the model expand into enumerated instances without per-instance operations.
Claims separate live-model evidence from the P065 scripted proof, and partial progress is closed honestly as partial.

items.goal: Full-scale reconstruction reference derivation as the runtime workspace's first tenant: four staged derivations at metre-cell footprint granularity inside the 4096 bound, each stage passing its declaration gate and axial-symmetry gate, every dimension citing an adopted fact or a typed widened-range uncertainty, materials assigned through the provenance ledger, final fidelity measured against the adopted dimensions, records living in the workspace with anchors in the repo.
acceptance: The project is bootstrapped in the runtime workspace; the repo holds only an anchor.
Stage 0 passes a project-authored declaration contract whose every range cites retained adoptions, plus the axial-symmetry gate, before any ACCEPTED archive.
Stages 1-3 deepen the same component identities through the exact-predecessor lifecycle with their own gates; dimensions cite adoptions or typed uncertainties, never inventions.
The material ledger covers the components with citable sources and types the remainder unassigned.
A fidelity receipt compares realized measures against the adopted dimensions; CAD/IFC externalizations carry materials.

The explicit progress surface reads retained 3DM files without starting Rhino, checks digest, object count, model units, and current geometry-program identity, and remains blocked unless exact branch evidence and convergence records close.

items.goal: Produce the CAADRIA 2027 full paper from the submitted abstract and frozen records: Chinese working draft first, then the English manuscript in the official template; every number resolves to a retained record, every abstract promise is marked delivered / to-record / to-run / to-decide, and the contract and outline are re-based on the submitted abstract.
acceptance: Chinese draft v0 exists and marks every abstract promise as delivered, to-record, to-run, or to-decide.
PAPER_CONTRACT.md and OUTLINE.md are re-based on the submitted abstract; repair locality becomes a secondary question.
Decision records exist for the three-regime comparison and for the two preliminary-result episodes.
Every manuscript number resolves to a retained record; a numbers-to-records table accompanies the draft.
Figures 1-5 and Tables 1-2 carry source manifests; anonymisation, AI-use statement, and manual citation verification complete before submission.

items.goal: A resident Rhino export host: one COM process across the exports of a run, with exact ownership proven per script and document isolation between exports, so the incremental patch path's saved work turns into saved wall clock. Retires one process per export; the per-export bridge stays as the fallback and the equivalence oracle.
acceptance: One Rhino process runs every seat export of a run; ownership is proven once and re-proven per script.
Second and later exports cost materially less than the first, measured on the villa and Rocca and reported as a table.
Per-process export remains available, is what the oracle uses, and a host failure falls back to it with a typed receipt.
Documents do not leak between exports; a violation fails typed.
Full unittest suite and the architecture firewall pass.

items.goal: Give the canonical producers the vocabulary the monuments are written in: solids of revolution and the boolean chain the Pantheon's dome and drum need, and the Doric and Ionic member families plus the roof and entablature fields the Parthenon's 687 retained operations are made of, dimensioned by a derivation table in module ratios and placed by grid reference. Retires that vocabulary as operation kinds invented inside a per-building tool.
acceptance: revolve, solid and boolean_difference producers read references and carry no authored coordinates; the Pantheon's 14 retained operations reproduce within 1 mm.
The Doric member family is produced from a derivation table in module ratios and reproduces each of the Parthenon's 104-member kinds within 1 mm from grid references.
Roof and entablature fields are arrays over reference lines, not authored per member.
Every producer publishes the datum its neighbour binds; engagements declared, no unexplained epsilon.
Full unittest suite and the architecture firewall pass.

items.goal: Extract Pantheon and Parthenon State Records from their retained records, replay them through the runner with object-by-object equivalence receipts, inventory every monolith entry point against where its behaviour lives afterwards, then retire the per-building tools to typed stubs. Retires the per-building runner monoliths, once their behaviour is reachable without them.
acceptance: Pantheon and Parthenon State Records are extracted from retained records and run through the runner.
Both reproduce their retained programs object by object within tolerance, recorded as equivalence receipts.
An inventory names every monolith entry point and where its behaviour lives afterwards; anything without a destination is carded before the file is touched.
The retired tools are typed stubs naming their replacement; their tests move to the runner path.
Full unittest suite and the architecture firewall pass.

items.goal: An in-process OCCT executor interprets the same CompiledGeometryProgram the Rhino path runs, tessellates preview meshes, measures bounds against the analytic predictor, exports STEP always and mesh .3dm via rhino3dm, and drives incremental re-execution from the patch selector. Receipts carry an evidence tier (self-measured cold-read vs independent instrument). Retires Rhino as the only execution path; the Rhino executor becomes the stage-gate certifier.
acceptance: Villa and Rocca records execute in-process within 3 mm of analytic bounds; full-rebuild and one-object wall clocks reported as measurements.
First certification compares both lanes object by object on both projects.
Receipts carry evidence tier and tessellator identity; STEP opens in Rhino with identity preserved.
Coplanar boolean edge cases have a tuning receipt.
Full unittest suite and the architecture firewall pass.

items.goal: The vibe modeling frontend rebuilt inside the apps/archflow-studio namespace as web/ (Vite+React, OpenAPI-generated client) and api/ (FastAPI + Pydantic + uvicorn as BFF only: request validation, SSE, task lifecycle; state, dependencies, validation, geometry and commit are archflow calls), executed by a separate session under Kaiwen's direction. Retires Preview Slice 01 (stdlib gateway, presence-probe kernel, monolithic shell, old launcher) behind tag studio-preview-slice-01; migrates the viewer assets and the six reserved protocols by moving. Round one stops at the validation receipt with no canonical commit. Bound by the machine-enforced firewall on api/, the DO-NOT-REBUILD inventory, the migrated ports seam, and the AGENTS.md one-in-one-out rule.
acceptance: The round-one chain (exact HEAD, bound StateRecord, component and dependency projection, intent on a selected component, typed proposal or BLOCKED_NEEDS_HUMAN, impact closure, detached candidate artifact with SHA, validation receipt) runs end to end on one configured external project with no canonical commit.
The six reserved protocols exist verbatim in api/archflow_studio_api/ports.py; viewer assets are moved, not copied; nothing is copied into a live archive directory.
Every exported object carries the existing archflow user-string identity; no second key set; no Pydantic model mirrors an archflow schema.
Held, violated and unchecked relation checks are shown as three states; the server issues the advance verdict.
Tests: contract, API, stale-base, cross-project rejection, UI state; archcheck stays green throughout.
Tag studio-preview-slice-01 marks the last commit where the demo is intact.
notes: Kernel gaps carded from the 2026-09-03 calibration: P109 (typed operator on StateRecord@1; Studio carries the candidate under the card) and P110 (CanonicalState projection; receipt labelled vacuous until it lands). P108 does not depend on either for round one.

items.goal: A kernel function applies a typed intent to a StateRecord@1 and returns the successor record: exact-base check on state_digest, protected set checked against the record's closure, deterministic, no propagation (propagation is the runner's). Raised by the Studio's P108 calibration: DecisionOperator/compile_decision_operator are typed to OperationalMarkovState and nothing applies a typed intent to a StateRecord. Until it lands the Studio carries a single-value-replace candidate under this card (AGENTS.md rule 3). Retires that Studio candidate the day it lands.
acceptance: Exact-base, protected-set and single-value-change behaviour covered by tests in tests/test_state_record.py; one villa run through the verify_state_record harness.
The Studio's successor_record candidate is deleted in the same change; no second implementation remains.
python tools/archcheck.py passes.

items.goal: A CanonicalState projection for State-Record projects: canonical_state_from_dict accepts only CanonicalState@1, while a State-Record project's HEAD (load_current_state) is the ref-based CanonicalProjectState@1 and its snapshot record is CanonicalSnapshot@2, so validate_submission can only be given CanonicalState(ref=head) with empty facts, commitments and obligations, on which ObligationDischargeValidator and AuthorizedCommitmentClaimsValidator have nothing to check. Project open_obligations from record.obligations, commitments from the record's authorized commitments, artifacts and facts from the run's receipts; one named path beside developed_design_view, or canonical_state_from_dict learns the ref-based shape, never both. Retires the labelled-vacuous validation receipt in P108.
acceptance: Villa HEAD plus bound record projects to a CanonicalState whose ref equals read_head() and whose open obligations equal the record's.
validate_submission on that state exercises ObligationDischargeValidator and AuthorizedCommitmentClaimsValidator on real content; a test shows a finding is reachable.
The Studio drops the 'unavailable' label and the empty-facts construction in the same change.
python tools/archcheck.py passes.
